subject: Ariba login assertion truncation — POs not visible after invite
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@auroraworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@auroraworks.com
Date: 2026-12-16T09:12:00Z
Subject: Can't finish Ariba invite / POs not visible
Attachments: screenshot-ariba-error.png (image/png)

Hi Jordan,

We accepted the Ariba invite yesterday but when we log in the supplier account shows 0 POs and the portal redirects back to the accept screen. The UI shows a short error: "Assertion processing failed: nameid truncated" (screenshot attached). Our procurement team needs visibility on open POs today — can you advise?

Tenant ID: aurora-0831
Example PO we expect to see: PO-48271

We tried in Chrome and Safari (incognito) with same result. The invite link path looks normal. Happy to provide screenshots or SAML logs.

Thanks,
Marta Alvarez
Procurement Manager, AuroraWorks
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@auroraworks.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-16T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Can't finish Ariba invite / POs not visible

Hi Marta — thanks for the details and the screenshot, that helps.

Quick checklist while we triage from our side:
- Can you send the SAML response (base64) or a stripped snippet showing the NameID? If possible, include the exact value rather than a screenshot — sometimes IdP assertions include an org prefix that gets truncated by our Ariba tenant mapping.
- Confirm whether your IdP NameID format is "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified" or emailAddress.
- If you can reproduce the flow, save the browser network request for the POST to /SAML/SSO and forward the body.

Workarounds until we have a fix:
1) If your IdP can change NameID to the raw email (no prefixes), that typically resolves the truncation.
2) I can open a temporary support session to manually map the assertion for tenant aurora-0831 so POs surface — need your sign-off.

Ben and Rafael, looping you here — we've seen assertion truncation before when NameID contains tenant-scoped prefixes like "aurora\<artifact\>user@". Rafael, can engineering check whether the tenant mapping layer is dropping characters on the NameID at the relay-state boundary?

Marta — if you can attach the SAMLResponse snippet and ariba-accept-flow-log.txt I can escalate.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-16T13:22:00Z
Subject: internal: quick note on NameID truncation pattern

Jordan / Rafael — short note from the field ops playbook: when IdP sends NameID with any non-alphanumeric prefix (org token, tenant id, or XML-escaped fragment) the Ariba connector we use will trim at the first non-email char unless the NameID is explicitly formatted as emailAddress. Two quick things to validate on IdP side:
- Ensure NameID format is set to emailAddress; SAML 2.0 binding with NameIDPolicy emailAddress recommended.
- If they cannot change it, we can add a normalization step on the assertion path for aurora-0831 (small config change, low risk) but that requires tenant-level sign-off.

Also, engineering note: if assertion payload > 1024 chars we sometimes see truncation on relay state header rewrite; prod infra team has a patch queued. Rafael — can ops bump that to high?

—Ben
From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@auroraworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@auroraworks.com
Date: 2026-12-17T08:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Can't finish Ariba invite / POs not visible

Thanks Jordan — attaching the SAML snippet and a short log we captured.

Attachments: saml-response-snippet.xml (application/xml), ariba-accept-flow-log.txt (text/plain)

Excerpt from SAMLResponse (stripped):
<NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified">aurora|user.marta@auroraworks.com</NameID>

So it looks like our IdP (Onelogin) is including a pipe-delimited prefix. I'll ask our IdP admin if they can change the NameID format to emailAddress and remove the prefix. If they prefer not to, please proceed with the normalization patch. Procurement is on a deadline so we appreciate a quick temp mapping if possible.

Marta
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@auroraworks.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-18T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Can't finish Ariba invite / POs not visible — plan and next steps

Hi Marta — thanks for the SAML snippet, that confirms the pipe-delimited prefix is the cause. Summary and plan: 

1) Temporary tenant mapping (48 hours) — Rafael's team will add a normalization rule for tenant aurora-0831 that strips any leading token up to the first "@" in the NameID. This will immediately surface existing POs. ETA: 4 hours after ops approval.

2) Recommended permanent fix — change NameID format to emailAddress on AuroraWorks' IdP (Onelogin). We will provide the exact SAML metadata and NameID policy sample.

3) I'll create a short runbook for your IdP admin and copy our recommended SAML settings into the Shared Drive link below. After you confirm the mapping works, we can remove the temporary tenant normalization.

Operational items: please reply with "Approve tenant mapping" if AuroraWorks wants us to apply the 48-hour mapping. Once approved, Rafael will open the JIRA (JIRA-OPS-1298) and notify your procurement alias when POs are visible.

Shared runbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cAuroraWorkOnboardNotes

If you prefer to change IdP settings instead, I can validate their test assertion once done. Either path works.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

--
